messages:
ashley: Quick question — running FP8 KV-only on a prod canary and seeing weird cold-start latency spikes when prefix cache hit rate drops below ~40%. Anyone seen this with prefix+KV quant combos?

max: Yeah, I've seen similar with AWQ runs. My hypothesis was a dequant/decompress penalty when KV gets populated after a prefix mismatch. What's the model variant + batch size?

ashley: It's a gpt-ish 6B derivative we onboarded (patched weights), batch=1, seq=1024, heavy prefixing for system messages. Baseline INT8 KV had ~8% memory reduction; FP8 gives ~12% mem savings but we're seeing latency tail +30-90ms for the first ~5 requests in a session.

priya: Can you paste the perf snapshot? Interested in `rtt` percentiles and `kv_cache_hit` from benchbot run. Also the warmup policy used.

benchbot: ```
run_id: canary-2003456789
model: rdx-6b-kv-patched
batch: 1
seq: 1024
rtt_p50: 42ms
rtt_p95: 78ms
rtt_p99: 182ms
rtt_p99_cold_first5: 260ms
kv_cache_hit_rate_overall: 62%
kv_cache_hit_rate_prefixed: 35%
mem_rss_fp8: 12.3GB
mem_rss_int8: 13.7GB
switches_per_session: 0-2 (observed)
notes: p99 spike aligns with sessions that have low prefix hit rate
```

max: Looks like the p99 jumps correlate with cache-miss-heavy sessions on the FP8 endpoint. Two mitigations we used before: 1) a `prefix_warmup` policy that pre-populates KV for the first N tokens, 2) hybrid fallback — route cold sessions to INT8 kernels until KV warmed, then switch to FP8.

liam: Hybrid fallback is relatively straightforward in routing layer: set `cold_threshold=3` (requests), route to `int8-kv` for <= cold_threshold, then flip route to `fp8-kv` for that session. We already have session-affinity hooks so flips are cheap.

ashley: Any eval/quality delta when doing cold->INT8? For our reranker use-case we care about top-k logits stability.

priya: Ran our 500-prompt regression suite (mix of short/long, exact-match heavy). Results: top-1 alignment delta ~0.7% for INT8 cold path vs baseline FP16. Most regressions concentrated in long-context exact-match tasks (seq>2048). FP8 warm path kept parity with baseline for our thresholds.

max: Tradeoffs summary (observational):
- cold latency: INT8 cold +20-50ms vs FP8 cold +30-90ms (observed p99 cold)
- memory: FP8 slightly lower RSS vs INT8 in this model shape
- quality: INT8 small regressions on long-context exact-match; FP8 better fidelity
Recommendation: ship canary profile `hybrid_int8_warmfp8` with `hot_threshold=3` and `prefix_warmup=true` for long-prefixed workloads.

ashley: I've pushed the flag `kv_quant_policy=hybrid_int8_warmfp8` to the canary group. @canary-bot please spin a 10k synthetic session job with seq distribution skewed to long prefixes (70% >512).

canary-bot: Started job 2003456799 — synthetic_sessions=10000, seq_dist=skew_long, ETA ~18m. Will emit run summary + histograms to /runs/canary-2003456799 when complete.

priya: Also recommend adding `kv_quant_switch_count` metric (per-session counter) to alert if sessions flip too often — flips cause cache churn and jitter.

max: One more gotcha: older runtime kernels (pre-2.14) show minor allocator stalls when FP8 path triggers memory fragmentation under heavy churn. If enabling FP8 on canary nodes, upgrade runtime to >=2.14 first.

ashley: Solid. We'll wait for the canary summary. If numbers match recommendations, plan is: roll to dedicated pool with `warmup=on`, update runbook section "KV quantization profiles" and add a follow-up eval job against production traffic sampling. :thumbsup:
